verdict.rationale: Godot documents one-click export to web-based platforms. Community reports add caveats: C# projects cannot export to the web, and one user moved back to 3.5.2 because its web export worked well. Missing for 10: any evidence on payload size, explicit WebGL renderer details, a WebGPU roadmap or support, and web export for C# projects.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story

citations.quote: Games can be exported with one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile platforms (Android, iOS), as well as Web-based platforms and consoles.
Godot 3.5.2 is still the LTS version and still exports just great for the web
